current_rd_text: Leader routing style. The default "radial" measures actual text boxes, separates site anchors from final radial label positions, and routes either a direct connector or an independent radial stub plus fan segment. All enzyme-facing text edges follow one close circular contour in genomic order. Dense lateral clusters use evenly spaced contour fans, while sparse clusters retain their natural angular positions. The former "trunk" alias was removed in v0.16.1; use "radial". "straight" connects the tick tip directly to the final label edge, without detours around the sequence or other leaders. "elbow" uses one bend, starting with a local-normal departure where possible. Label positions and grouping are shared by all routing styles.
